{{Quote|The Caspel has a bad reputation in certain circles, but only among troops that don't keep their weapons clean. They claim that it jams and ignites the canister while it's in the launcher.|Lieutenant [[Harburik]]|<ref name="ISB" />}}
The '''CSPL-12 projectile launcher''' was a personal [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]].

==Description==
[[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]' CSPL-12 was a personal [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]] capable of launching several different canisters dependent on tactical combat requirements. The canisters were either stored in the launcher, or in the magazine of the weapon, which could hold four extra canisters. An adapter, the [[PL/1G]], was available that could convert the CSPL-12 to fire [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].<ref name="ISB" />

The CSPL-12 had the ability to fire several canister types; a [[dye canister]] which was able to mark terrain in a ten-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius, a [[Smoke canister/Legends|smoke canister]] for obscuring vision and marking terrain, a [[T-238 canister]] which induced nausea and incapacitated targets, [[CryoBan canister]]s which froze targets and incapacitated them, [[Plank Gas canister]]s which delivered corrosive damage, [[Spore/B canister]]s which caused unconsciousness through the use of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bothan stun spore|stun spores]], and a [[Fex-M3 canister]] which released [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve gas]], causing death.<ref name="ISB" />

The CSPL-12 was known to periodically jam, igniting the canister in the chamber. However, it was found that this only generally occurred when the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] handling the weapon failed to properly clean and maintain the weapon. It was found that dirt could get caught in the canister's primary pin, which caused the weapon to jam.<ref name="ISB" />

==History==
An improperly cleaned and maintained weapon jammed and ignited during an Imperial operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lafra]], which resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Azarin]].<ref name="ISB" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] that infiltrated the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] carried a CSPL launcher, and it was used by [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Delevar]] to smoke out the crew of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] during the squad's advance on the shield bunker.<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=Night Attack|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref>

The [[Relby-v10 micro grenade launcher/Legends|Relby-v10 micro grenade launcher]] was based on the CSPL-12 design.<ref name="Dagobah">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Bossk's Mortar Gun}}</ref>
